issues.description: Method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as returning String, but the solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as returning int. The template (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) contains a TODO for this method but no signature. This mismatch between the UML and the solution confuses students about the expected return type and can cause compilation/test mismatches if tests or reference solutions expect a different type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: update the UML in problem_statement.md so the signature reads getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int and update any textual references that imply a String return. Alternatively, if the design intentionally requires a String, change the solution (and any tests) so getTotalNumberOfStudents() returns a String (e.g., String.valueOf(total)). Ensure template TODO/code examples match the chosen return type.
